articles.title: File Mover Express: AWS Releases Open-Source Tool for S3 File Transfers
articles.author: Renato Losio
articles.summary: AWS has recently released File Mover Express, an open-source application under the Apache 2.0 license for transferring large files between local systems and Amazon S3. Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux, it supports parallel transfers, automatic performance tuning, retries, pause and resume, and file integrity verification. By Renato Losio

articles.title: AWS Capacity Largely Sold Out Through 2027, With On Demand Headroom Reserved
articles.author: Steef-Jan Wiggers
articles.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says AWS’s large committed cloud capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with part of 2028 already allocated, while the company continues to reserve headroom for On Demand, EC2 and Bedrock. Practitioners discussing the remarks report difficulty obtaining On Demand capacity for ordinary EC2 instances, and similar constraints at other providers. By Steef-Jan Wiggers
